headword: {乳糖不耐症|にゅうとうふたいしょう}
reading: にゅうとうふたいしょう

definitions.explanation: A condition in which the body cannot properly digest lactose (the sugar in milk and dairy products) due to insufficient production of the enzyme lactase. Symptoms include bloating, diarrhea, and stomach pain after consuming dairy.

examples.japanese: {乳糖不耐症|にゅうとうふたいしょう}なのでミルクが{飲|の}めない。
examples.english: I have lactose intolerance, so I can't drink milk.

examples.japanese: {乳糖不耐症|にゅうとうふたいしょう}の{人|ひと}には{乳糖|にゅうとう}{除去|じょきょ}ミルクが{適|てき}している。
examples.english: Lactose-free milk is suitable for people with lactose intolerance.

examples.japanese: {乳糖不耐症|にゅうとうふたいしょう}は{東|ひがし}アジア{系|けい}の{人|ひと}に{多|おお}く{見|み}られる{消化器|しょうかき}{疾患|しっかん}だ。
examples.english: Lactose intolerance is a digestive condition commonly found among people of East Asian descent.

notes:
{乳糖|にゅうとう} means lactose; {不耐症|ふたいしょう} means intolerance (inability to tolerate). The condition is particularly prevalent among East Asians.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {乳糖不耐症|にゅうとうふたいしょう}がある: to have lactose intolerance
- {乳糖不耐症|にゅうとうふたいしょう}と{診断|しんだん}される: to be diagnosed with lactose intolerance
- {乳糖|にゅうとう}{除去|じょきょ}ミルク: lactose-free milk
- {乳糖|にゅうとう}{不耐|ふたい}: lactose intolerance (abbreviated form)
